mcp.description: MCP servers and their tools (GitHub, the vault...): status, tools, on/off, approve changes

gateway_down: 🔴 I couldn't reach the MCP gateway ({error}). Is the "mcp" container up? Everything else keeps working.
gateway_later: (The gateway didn't answer: {error}. It applies when it's back.)
no_servers: No MCP servers configured. Add them to data/mcp.json by hand, then /mcp reload.
hint: /mcp tools <server> lists the tools; history: /log today mcp.
no_tools: No tools for {server} (is it ready? /mcp shows the servers).

flag.flagged: 🚫 blocked: looks like instructions to the assistant ({reason})

no_store: I can't save that now (database unavailable).
turned_off: ⏸ MCP server {server} turned off: its tools are gone until /mcp on {server}.
nothing_to_approve: Nothing to approve on {server}: no tool definition changed.
unknown_server: There's no MCP server {server}. Servers: {servers}. New servers are only added by hand in data/mcp.json.
status_line: 🔌 MCP: {ready}/{servers} servers ready, {tools} tools · today {calls} calls, {failed} failed
